|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current text; the current text is [[Despair (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this text ([[:File:V1-D-despair-original.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-de022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier copy of its text was found). Document: no errata mark; margin “•Despair”. Text: “Deploy on table. Opponent's characters deploy +1 to same site as Jabba's Prize. When you capture a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Your Force drains at same battleground site as Jabba's Prize are +1. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Despair (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-dea5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' rewritten: My Favorite Decoration clause moved first; deploy +1 and Force drain +1 now both “at same site as Jabba's Prize” (drain no longer limited to a battleground site); “When you capture a character, opponent loses 1 Force” removed; adds “While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3”. (Holotable card data first shows this text on 14 May 2020; dating evidence only.) Document: errata mark “E”; margin “Despair” (no dot). Text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1. While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Despair (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 3 October 2022<ref name="img-deca1ccff">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous image; the PC re-made the image at higher resolution and the errata mark now prints “E1” (the previous image printed “E”). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; margin “Despair”. Text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1. While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Despair (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 30 December 2024<ref name="img-de9d2c01e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b commit 9d2c01e] (30 December 2024); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Dark/large/despair.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “At same site as Jabba's Prize, opponent's characters deploy +1 and your Force drains are +1” → “At battlegrounds where you have a frozen captive, your Force drains are +1” (the deploy +1 clause removed); “While Jabba's Prize with Scum And Villainy” → “While a frozen captive with Scum And Villainy”. It is the current text (same file as the wiki's existing image). Document: errata mark “E2”; margin “Despair”. Text: “Deploy on table. My Favorite Decoration may not be placed out of play. At battlegrounds where you have a frozen captive, your Force drains are +1. While a frozen captive with Scum And Villainy, your total power in all battles is +3. [Immune to Alter.]”
